## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] `pnpm prettier --check` passes on the changed files
- [ ] New or changed texts exist in English **and** German (`apps/web/messages/{en,de}`)
- [ ] Database changes come with a new migration (no edited released migrations)
- [ ] No organisation-specific data or secrets
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` ([Unreleased]) updated if behaviour changed
